name: terminal-recording-sync-quarantine

graded_by.test: owed: U2 `recording_sync_failure_quarantine`: a failed recording fsync appends unconfirmed recording_unsynced at bbolt's commit point P, below A; no exact fact above P and no release_accounted, in the running core and after a restart; a restart keeps the commit point at P, so its hello carries P's seq, and no realign or later successful fsync lifts the quarantine; the §8 notice reuses the key at P; a failed quarantine append leaves only the in-process rule.

description: U2 `recording_sync_failure_quarantine`: a failed recording fsync appends unconfirmed recording_unsynced at bbolt's commit point P, below A; no exact fact above P and no release_accounted, in the running core and after a restart; a restart keeps the commit point at P, so its hello carries P's seq, and no realign or later successful fsync lifts the quarantine; the §8 notice reuses the key at P; a failed quarantine append leaves only the in-process rule.

instances.note: The durable quarantine (#137): the running core saw the recording's fsync fail and wrote this at P, the session record's commit point in bbolt (recording_last_seq_out 40, out_bytes_committed 8000), below the walk's A (42, 8192). The pair is never relied on above P.
recording_unsynced is an unconfirmed reason only: an entirely unrecorded session has no recording pair to quarantine.
The quarantine names the pair it quarantines: recording_path is required, as for every unconfirmed fact.
